selectLanguageDescription: Sankhani chiyankhulo cha ntchito yoyika ndi chiyankhulo chachikale cha tsamba.
verifyRequirementsDescription: Onani kuti chilengedwe cha seva yanu chikukwaniritsa zofunika zogwiritsira HAX.
allRequirementsMet: Zofunika zonse zakwaniritsidwa. Mungapitire pamalopo patsamba lotsatira.
configureSystemDescription: Konzani akaunti ya woyang'anira ya tsamba latsopano la HAX.
passwordHelp: Siyanitsi potuluka kuti mupeze mawu achinsinsi ovomerezeka omwe amapangidwa okha, kapena lowani ma chara 10+ okhala ndi chikalata chimoza ndi nambala imoja.
saveCredentialsWarning: Zofunika: Sungani zizindikiro izi tsopano. Ili nthawi yomwe ingaonetsedwe kokha.
haxcmsMascotAlt: Chizindikiro cha HAXcms Woyenda ku Tsogolo
languageHelp: Lembani dzina, dzina la chilankhulocho kapena khodi.
usernameHelp: Zilembo, manambala, kadontho, kansalu ndi mzere wapansi.
versionAfterSignIn: Mtundu wa HAXcms ndi njira zonse za seva zimawonekera mu kayendetsedwe ka dongosolo mukalowa.
foreverTitle: HAX yanu ndi yanu, mpaka kalekale
foreverFiles: Masamba anu ndi mafayilo wamba mu _sites, otsatiridwa ndi git kuyambira tsiku loyamba.
foreverStandards: Yamangidwa pa miyezo ya intaneti, kotero zomwe mumapanga zimapitiriza kugwira ntchito pamene HAXcms ikusinthidwa.
foreverPortable: Tengani tsamba kulikonse: limayenda pa HAXcms mu PHP kapena Node, kapena ngati mafayilo osasintha.
foreverPillar: Yokhazikika: yomangidwa kuti ikhalitse, yopepuka pa dziko lapansi.
tvArtCredit: Zojambula za Future Traveler kuchokera ku haxtheweb/art. TV imawoneka chimodzimodzi mu kuwala ndi mdima.
padNote: HAX Blocks pa tchanelo 2: thamangani ndi otsutsa atatu kuti mutenge magawo a HAX. A imagwira (kapena imagunda wotsutsa pafupi nanu), B imabwezera limodzi, Select imasinthanso womenya wanu, Start imasindikiza. Kiyibodi yanu imagwiranso ntchito: mivi, A ndi B zimawalitsa batani lomwe zikanikiza.
tipDifferenceTitle: Kusiyana kwa HAX: zomwe mumapanga zimapitiriza kugwira ntchito
tipDifference: Masamba anu ndi HTML ya miyezo ya intaneti m'mafayilo wamba omwe ndi anu, otsatiridwa ndi git. Pafupifupi tsamba lililonse lopangidwa ndi HAX kuyambira 2020 likugwirabe ntchito lero, ndipo tsamba limasamuka pakati pa HAXcms mu PHP, mu Node kapena kusungidwa kosasintha monga lilili. Yomangidwa kuti ikhalitse, yopepuka pa dziko lapansi.
tipFilesTitle: Bweretsani mafayilo anu ndipo muwapange HAX
tipFiles: Mukamaliza kuyika, Lowetsani pa dashibodi imasandutsa izi kukhala tsamba la HAX lomwe mungasinthe, kupanganso ndi kutenga kulikonse.
tipSites: Lozani Lowetsani ku adiresi ya tsamba ndipo masamba ake amalowa ngati masamba ndi magawo a HAX.
tipBooks: Mabuku otseguka ndi malo osungira a docs-as-code amakhala tsamba la HAX ndi ndondomeko yawo yosasinthika.
tipPassword: Sitepe yomaliza imawonetsa zolowera zanu zatsopano kamodzi kokha. Zisungeni mu chosungira mawu achinsinsi musanayambitse HAXcms.
